submissions.note: In the Kaliski binary-GCD modular inverse, the (r,s) Bezout cswaps of step9(k) and step3(k+1) carry consecutive controls with no register read between them, so they merge across the iteration boundary via cswap(a_k)*cswap(a_{k+1}) carried by a single frame parity qubit (allocated only over the boundary span). One Fredkin replaces two => -274k Toffoli (the (r,s) half of the cswap mass), peak-neutral, and pure-unitary so global phase is preserved. Gate KAL_CSWAP_RS_MERGE (default on); =0 restores the prior baseline exactly.
